storyScope.centralIncident: Nighttime routine traffic stop escalates into a high-stakes standoff when the nervous driver hides a loaded weapon under his passenger jacket.
storyScope.centralViewerQuestion: Why is the driver desperately hiding his hands under a jacket during a routine traffic stop?
storyScope.primaryConflict: Driver refusing direct commands to show hands; officer drawing taser after spotting weapon silhouette.
storyScope.initialState: Patrol car initiates routine traffic stop for expired tags.
storyScope.targetEndState: Driver is extracted at gunpoint, weapon recovered, and active armed robbery warrant revealed.
storyScope.mainOpenLoop: What is concealed under the driver's jacket and why is he willing to risk getting shot?

centralViewerQuestion: Why is the driver desperately hiding his hands under a jacket during a routine traffic stop?
hookPromise: Suspenseful nighttime traffic stop that accelerates from routine questions into drawn weapons and felony warrants.

beats.newInformation: Patrol lights activate behind dark sedan; driver hesitates for 200 yards before pulling over.
beats.viewerQuestionBefore: Why is the sedan delaying pulling over?
beats.whyThisBeatNow: Establishes initial suspense without premature teaser spoiler.

beats.newInformation: Officer approaches driver window; driver is visibly trembling and breathing rapidly.
beats.whyThisBeatNow: Direct physical evidence of extreme suspect anxiety.

beats.newInformation: Officer requests driver's license; driver claims he has no ID and gives a fake name.
beats.whyThisBeatNow: First verbal deception introduces legal jeopardy.

beats.newInformation: Flashlight beam spots driver right hand tucked deep inside a heavy winter jacket on passenger seat.
beats.viewerStateAfter: Spotting concealed hand; threat level spikes.
beats.whyThisBeatNow: Visual discovery shifts routine stop to potential lethal encounter.

beats.newInformation: Officer issues urgent tactical command: 'Put both hands on the steering wheel right now!'
Driver refuses command and plunges hand deeper: 'I am just grabbing my insurance!'
beats.viewerStateAfter: Shocked by direct defiance in front of flashlight.
beats.whyThisBeatNow: Peak non-compliance pushes situation to weapon draw.

beats.newInformation: Officer draws taser with red laser aimed at chest: 'Step out of the vehicle or you will be tased!'
Second police cruiser skids to a halt; high-beam spotlight floods the sedan cabin.
beats.whyThisBeatNow: Overwhelming force arrival changes power dynamic.

beats.newInformation: Driver kicks door open and raises hands, shouting: 'Do not shoot me, I am coming out!'
Officers pin driver against hood and secure wrists in double-locking steel handcuffs.
Backup officer searches the passenger jacket and lifts out a loaded Glock 19 with scratched serial numbers.
beats.viewerStateAfter: Lethal threat confirmed; viewer sees illegal firearm.
beats.whyThisBeatNow: Core evidence payoff of the concealed jacket loop.

beats.newInformation: Driver from police cruiser curb: 'That is not my gun, somebody borrowed my car two hours ago!'
beats.whyThisBeatNow: Single punchy suspect defense highlighting guilt.

beats.newInformation: Dispatch radios confirmation: Driver fingerprints match Marcus Vance, wanted for armed robbery and aggravated assault with active extradition warrant!
beats.viewerStateAfter: Massive felony warrant reveal shifts stakes to major violent crime prosecution.
beats.cliffhangerQuestion: Will Marcus Vance face armed robbery charges in Part 2 after his false identity collapsed?
beats.cliffhangerNewInformation: Dispatch confirms driver is an armed robbery fugitive with active violent felony warrants.
beats.cliffhangerExpectedNextPayoff: Part 2 reveals interrogation confession and felony booking details.
